lines.en: Scan with the big eye
Move slowly, searching for light
Stare at the player, closing in
Stare, seeking prey
Approach the light source, ready to destroy
My one big eye never blinks.

lines.zh: 缓缓游走，寻找下一个目标
lines.en: Creep along, searching for a new target
Watch for the player, moving stealthily

lines.zh: 盯着玩家，准备发起攻势
lines.en: Gaze at the player, preparing to attack
Seeking light to destroy

lines.zh: 大眼左右转动，扫过石壁。
lines.en: Its great eye swivels, sweeping the stone walls.

lines.zh: 它绕着熄灭的火把走开。
lines.en: It walks away around a dead torch.
Staring into the deep eye hole
Standing quietly in the shadows
Staring ahead, waiting for an opportunity
Staring for a long time, searching for prey
Standing still, deep in thought
Observing quietly in the darkness
Staring for a long time, searching for a target
Standing in the shadow, wary of the player
There is no light in this cave but me.
Staring for a long time, waiting for an opportunity
Its eye droops half shut, as if dozing.
It stares at a crack in the cave roof.

lines.zh: 独眼一动不动，像块玻璃。
lines.en: The single eye sits still as glass.

lines.zh: 它在熄灭的火堆边停住。
lines.en: It stops beside a burnt-out fire.
My pupil is bigger than your head.

lines.zh: 我这一只眼，只看得见你。
lines.en: My single eye sees only you.
Staring intensely at the player
Staring intently at the player
Staring at the player, searching for a weakness
I have one eye, and it holds only you.

lines.zh: 死死盯着玩家，寻找机会
lines.en: Staring at the player, looking for an opportunity

lines.zh: 目光锁定玩家，寻找弱点
lines.en: Locking eyes on the player, searching for a weakness
Staring at the player, looking for an opening
Staring at the player, searching for an opportunity
That great eye turns wholly toward you.
Your torch shows in the white of its eye.

lines.zh: 你一抬手，它的眼珠就动。
lines.en: You lift a hand and its eye follows.
It fixes on the light in your hand.

lines.zh: 独眼眨也不眨，直直看你。
lines.en: The eye never blinks, just stares.

lines.zh: 它凑近，眼里只有你的倒影。
lines.en: It leans in; only your reflection fills it.

lines.zh: 它把你的影子收进瞳孔。
lines.en: It draws your shadow into its pupil.

lines.zh: 你的火把让它眯起了眼。
lines.en: Your torch makes its eye narrow.
It slips between you and the torch.
Its pupil contracts; it knows you.

lines.zh: 大眼一闭，疼得我快瞎了！
lines.en: My big eye hurts so much!

lines.zh: 我一只大眼，被戳得发白。
lines.en: My one big eye has been stabbed white.

lines.zh: 大眼快瞎了，我快不行了！
lines.en: My big eye is almost gone!
It hurts! It hurts!
My big eye hurts, help me!
You hit me! It hurts!
My big eye is hurt, it hurts!
This wound hurts, help!
I'm hurt, help!

lines.zh: 我的大眼受伤了，好痛苦！
lines.en: My big eye is hurt, it hurts!

lines.zh: 它的眼睛盯着你，让你无法离开。
lines.en: Its eye stares at you, trapping your path.

lines.zh: 那双大眼睛紧盯着你，让你害怕。
lines.en: Those big eyes fixed on you, making you afraid.

lines.zh: 它靠近你时，你感受到一股寒意。
lines.en: As it approaches, a chill runs down your spine.

lines.zh: 它似乎知道你身上的美味。
lines.en: It seems to know the delicious you carry.

lines.zh: 它的视线穿透你，令你不安。
lines.en: Its gaze pierces through you, unsettling.

lines.zh: 它的眼眸里映出你的影子。
lines.en: Its eyes reflect your shadow.

lines.zh: 它的一瞥足以令你颤抖。
lines.en: A glance from it makes you shudder.
Its eye holds a magical allure.

lines.zh: 你感到它的眼睛在暗中窥视。
lines.en: You feel its eye watching you in the dark.

lines.zh: 它的眼睛让你感到无处可逃。
lines.en: Its eye makes you feel trapped.

lines.zh: 你的身体撞上了它的视线。
lines.en: Your body hits its gaze.

lines.zh: 你撞上了它的凝视，痛苦难忍。
lines.en: You collide with its stare, in pain.
Its gaze cuts through you.

lines.zh: 你撞上了它的目光，无法移动。
lines.en: You collide with its gaze, unable to move.
You try to avoid its gaze.

lines.zh: 我这一只大眼，把你的光都看灭了。
lines.en: My one big eye watches your light go out.

lines.zh: 你撞上了它的凝视，身体僵硬。
lines.en: You collide with its gaze, your body freezing.

lines.zh: 它的视线让你难以招架。
lines.en: Its gaze overwhelms you.

lines.zh: 你撞上了它的目光，感到窒息。
lines.en: You collide with its gaze, feeling suffocated.

lines.zh: 它的视线让你无法移动。
lines.en: Its gaze immobilizes you.
It stares at your big eye.
Its gaze seems seductive.
Do not fear; I only want a closer look.

lines.zh: 它的眼神中透露出兴趣。
lines.en: Its eyes show interest.
Its gaze is full of affection.
Its eyes seem to communicate.
Its gaze is enticing.

lines.zh: 它的眼睛中有一种特殊的魅力。
lines.en: Its eyes have a special charm.

lines.zh: 它的目光似乎在寻找同伴。
lines.en: Its gaze seeks a partner.

lines.zh: 它的视线中充满了渴望。
lines.en: Its gaze is filled with longing.
Sssss, eye on you!
You have light on you!
My eye's brighter than yours.
I will blow out this lamp for you.
Your shadow moves.
In the dark, I see you.
Just a glance from me.
Don't let the light near.
Danger surrounds you.
You can't escape my gaze.
I have followed you since you entered.

lines.zh: 我这只眼，把你的火把记下了。
lines.en: This one eye has noted your torch.
No safe place around you.
I'll plunge you into darkness.
Now you belong to me.

lines.zh: 你把火把举高，我就盯那儿。
lines.en: Raise that torch - I'll stare right at it.
You're mine now.
With the torch out, I see better.
I'll keep watching you.
You can't escape.
It eyes your torch before it eyes you.

lines.zh: 光源灭了，它才开始看你。
lines.en: The light dies, and only then does it look at you.

lines.zh: 独眼中央浮起你的轮廓。
lines.en: Your outline forms at the center of its eye.

lines.zh: 它把头歪向光源的方向。
lines.en: It tilts its head toward the light.

lines.zh: 黑暗里，它锁定了你的呼吸。
lines.en: In the dark it locks onto your breathing.
It inches toward you block by block.

lines.zh: 我这一只眼，只装得下你。
lines.en: This one eye has room only for you.
That dark shape in the corner is me.
You're mine

lines.zh: 我的眼跟着你转，停不下
lines.en: My eye keeps turning after you and cannot stop.
Around the corner, I am still watching.

lines.zh: 火把灭了，我的眼还亮着。
lines.en: Your torch is out; my eye is still lit.

lines.zh: 我只有一只眼，看得更死。
lines.en: One eye only, and it stares harder.
You can't avoid me.
A black haze wells up in its eye.

lines.zh: 它盯着火把的火苗发呆。
lines.en: It stares blankly at the torch flame.

lines.zh: 火把的光被它挡住一半。
lines.en: It blocks half the torchlight.

lines.zh: 它的眼睛在你脸上停住。
lines.en: Its eye settles on your face.

lines.zh: 独眼一眨，洞里的光暗了。
lines.en: The eye blinks, and the cave dims.

lines.zh: 它想让这片黑暗更彻底。
lines.en: It wants this dark to be complete.

lines.zh: 它的眼球贴得离你很近。
lines.en: Its eyeball hangs very close to you.

lines.zh: 你在它的瞳孔里越变越大。
lines.en: You grow larger inside its pupil.

lines.zh: 它只等火光熄灭的瞬间。
lines.en: It waits for the flame to gutter out.
It stares at you, neither moving nor leaving.
A wet sheen rises over the eye.

lines.zh: 它把你连火光一起盯住。
lines.en: It pins you and the flame together.
Staring at you, hehe!
Your light is too bright!
Eye on your heart!
The only light in the darkness!
I just need your light!
Light, my prey!

lines.zh: 光源灭了，你什么也看不见。
lines.en: The light dies and you see nothing.
Target in my sight!

lines.zh: 我这一只眼，看你像看虫。
lines.en: With one eye, I see you as an insect.
You are my light!
One glare of that eye swallows all light!

lines.zh: 它扑过来撞熄你的火把！
lines.en: It lunges and smothers your torch!
That one eye slams into your chest!
It drives its skull down on your hand!

lines.zh: 黑暗中它咬住了你的肩！
lines.en: In the dark it bites your shoulder!

lines.zh: 它扑到光源上，连你一起撞！
lines.en: It throws itself at the light, and you with it!
Darkness calls me!
Light comes, I come!
Night is my stage!
Lights out, I appear!

lines.zh: 那只大眼睛睁开时，光就灭了。
lines.en: When my big eye opens, the light goes out.
Light gone, I eat!
Light comes, I wait for you!
The only creature in the night!
I appear in the light!
Find my light!

lines.zh: 最后一点火光熄了，它来了。
lines.en: The last flame dies, and it arrives.
The cave darkens and the eye opens.

lines.zh: 它从熄灭的火把旁站起来。
lines.en: It rises beside a torch it has put out.

lines.zh: 骨荒原上一只眼慢慢亮起。
lines.en: On the bone wastes, one eye slowly lights.

lines.zh: 灯灭的那刻，它就站在那儿。
lines.en: The moment the lamp dies, it is standing there.

lines.zh: 黑暗里浮出一枚惨白的眼球。
lines.en: A pale eyeball surfaces in the dark.

lines.zh: 它顺着光一路摸到这里。
lines.en: It followed the light all the way here.

lines.zh: 石缝深处，大眼睁开一条缝。
lines.en: Deep in the rock seam, the eye opens a slit.

lines.zh: 它把洞里的火一盏盏看灭。
lines.en: It stares the cave's fires out one by one.
As shadows stretch, it appears.

lines.zh: 大眼被烧伤了，快救救我！
lines.en: My big eye is burnt, help!

lines.zh: 从高处摔下，大眼受伤了！
lines.en: I fell from a height, my eye is hurt!

lines.zh: 大眼被水淹了，快救救我！
lines.en: My eye is drowning, help!
My big eye is blown, it hurts!
My big eye is hit, it hurts!

lines.zh: 魔法攻击伤了大眼，好疼！
lines.en: Magic hit my big eye, it hurts!

lines.zh: 没有食物，大眼受饿受伤！
lines.en: No food, my big eye is hungry!
Lightning hit my big eye, it hurts!
Void hit my big eye, it hurts!
